chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
And [authority] over those who are pious. But it is Iblis who commands their transgression, to test them with what He has given them.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Satan's authority over the faithful and the disbelievers?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority is not absolute but conditional, serving as a divine test for humanity. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle that while Satan has general sway over all, his specific dominion is limited to those who voluntarily follow his whispers, preserving the free will and ultimate security of the pious believers.
